title: Blind case sidecar
description: The ONLY visible metadata a BLIND case exposes. This is an allowlist, not a convenience: `additionalProperties: false` at every level means a field carrying case content cannot be added by accident, and a downstream ticket may never widen it by writing schemas/evaluation/** — that is a docs PR amending GOLD-01 and the requesting ticket (sub-PRD D3).
$comment: WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: question, anonymous_scenario, required_facts, prohibited_assumptions, expected_answer_status, acceptable_statuses, gold_authorities, required/optional/prohibited_claims, expected_clarifications, expected_refusal_reason, preconditions, input_structured_fields. Every one of those either IS the blind question or reveals the expected answer, and PRD §14.3 requires blind gold to remain outside ordinary coding-agent context. The fields that remain are exactly what stratification and allocation checking need — counts, categories and ids — which is why GOLD-05 … GOLD-14 can verify blind SLOTS without ever seeing content. VOCABULARY: inside the subset contracts.jsonschema_min implements.

split.description: A sidecar exists only for a BLIND case; a DEVELOPMENT or VALIDATION case is a plaintext case file.

change_reason.description: Why this blind slot exists in this dataset version. Content-free by discipline: it describes the correction, never the question.

envelope_digest.description: SHA-256 of the sealed ciphertext this sidecar accompanies. BLIND_SEALED fails when it disagrees with the envelope or with the dataset-version registry.
